title: baccharis racemosa
intro: Baccharis racemosa, commonly known as Coyote Mint or False Coyote Mint, is a perennial shrub native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of respiratory issues and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Baccharis racemosa include its ability to reduce fever, relieve coughs, and calm the digestive system. The bioactive constituents of the plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
